title: Duterte at the ICC: Prosecutors move to streamline trial with expert reports on drug war killings
summary: Prosecutors at the International Criminal Court (ICC) have formally applied to introduce expert reports and written testimony into evidence in the case against former president Rodrigo Duterte.
